title: Missing title/author rejected with 422, spec example cites 400
evidence: main.rs:87-92 validate() returns StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY for blank title/author; REQUIREMENTS.json R9 how_to_verify cites 400. 422 is a defensible semantic-validation code (malformed JSON still returns 400 via JsonRejection) and is documented in README.md:20.
suggestion: No action required; note the deliberate 422-vs-400 choice for cross-run status-code comparison.
